summary: Gives an overview of operational networking and transport issues that affect quality of experience when streaming video and other high-bitrate media over the Internet. It explains aspects of streaming delivery that have surprised network designers and transport experts without media experience. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Watching a video online needs a steady flow, not just speed. This explains why streaming behaves differently from other traffic and what trips up network builders.

questions: what affects video streaming quality on the internet
